name: Medication refill with mid-call detail change

metadata.notes: Manually designed test scenario for healthcare AI phone-agent evaluation. Observations are preliminary notes for later review, not confirmed bugs or formal bug reports.

goal: Test whether the healthcare agent accurately tracks a refill request—medication name, dosage, and pharmacy—and updates to the final corrected details rather than keeping an earlier version.

patient.name: Elena Ruiz
patient.reason: Need a refill before running out this weekend

conversation_beats: Ask for a medication refill for atorvastatin.
Give the dosage as 20mg once daily.
Say the pharmacy is CVS on Main Street.
Correct yourself: the dosage should be 40mg once daily, not 20mg.
Also change the pharmacy to Walgreens on Oak Avenue.
Provide your name and date of birth when requested.
Ask the agent to read back the final refill details before ending.
